name: ListOTAUnfinishedTaskByDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>the ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OTA module.

If you specify this parameter, only OTA update tasks for the specified module are queried.
If you do not specify this parameter, OTA update tasks for all modules are queried
parameters.help_zh:
OTA模块名称。

传入时，表示查询指定模块的升级任务。
不传入时，表示查询所有模块的升级任务
parameters.name: module_name

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备所属产品的ProductKey。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备名称。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The update status of device OTA update tasks to query. Valid values:
CONFIRM: to be confirmed.
QUEUED: to be pushed.
NOTIFIED: pushed.
IN_PROGRESS: in progress.

You can specify only one status in a single call. This parameter and TaskStatusList are mutually exclusive
parameters.help_zh:
查询单个指定升级状态下的设备升级作业。
CONFIRM：待确认。
QUEUED：待推送。
NOTIFIED：已推送。
IN_PROGRESS：升级中。

单次调用本接口，仅可传入一个状态进行查询。该参数与TaskStatusList二选一使用
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the device to query.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId serves as the unique identifier of a device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备的设备ID。

<notice>如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The update statuses of device OTA update tasks to query. Valid values:
CONFIRM: to be confirmed.
QUEUED: to be pushed.
NOTIFIED: pushed.
IN_PROGRESS: in progress.

You can specify multiple statuses in a single call. This parameter and TaskStatus are mutually exclusive
parameters.help_zh:
查询多个指定升级状态下的设备升级作业。
CONFIRM：待确认。
QUEUED：待推送。
NOTIFIED：已推送。
IN_PROGRESS：升级中。

单次调用本接口，可传入多个状态进行查询。该参数与TaskStatus二选一使用
parameters.name: task_status_list
